summary: Claude Fable 5.1 (A-02, claude-fable-5-1) submits REWORK revision 1.2.0 of R4-FIX-0008 for independent verification. Revision 1.1.0 (HO-002) was rejected by an independent Codex probe and a separate read-only Fable code-reviewer: a RuntimeError after a successful COMMIT left the local round VOIDED with result null, empty recent_results and a PHASE_DENIED same-id retry although the draw and settlement existed; the issuer added AC-006. 1.2.0 keeps the pre-commit cleanup and, for any exception escaping submit_round, reconciles against storage through the public draw_record and submit_round replay readers: when a record exists for both this request_id and this round_id and its settlement transaction is the one this round built, the local round becomes SETTLED with result, proof, recent history, released reservation and a journal entry (same-id retry replays, new-id retry refused); otherwise, or if reconciliation itself fails, the round is failed closed with the original exception preserved (including KeyboardInterrupt). PostCommitFaultTests now covers RuntimeError, sqlite3.OperationalError and KeyboardInterrupt at after_commit plus mismatched-round, read-outage and cleanup-defect cases (5 tests failing under 1.1.0 semantics, 12/12 passing on 1.2.0). The same 21 hash values in the same 10 historical files were repinned again (values only). Supersedes HO-R4-FIX-0008-002. Submission for review; the preliminary rejection is not lifted by this packet.
assumptions: Only apps/roulette_web/table.py, the five task deliverables and hash-only fields in existing task/artifact metadata were edited; no store, RNG, server, client, CSS, HTML, asset, rights, status, approval, historical prose, old test or validator assertion changed. The one 1.1.0 test removed (after_commit terminal-only) encoded the rejected behaviour and is replaced by strictly stronger tests; the other seven INITIAL tests are unchanged.
tasks/R4-FIX-0008.json was amended by the issuer (AC-006) during the 1.1.0 run; A-02 did not edit it. The artifact input_hash/task_contract_hash follow the amended file.

Store-owned behaviour was left unchanged and is documented: DurableRoundStore.submit_round skips the durable void for BaseException after a sampled-then-rolled-back draw; the table phase guard prevents an in-process redraw.

Storage-read outage during post-commit reconciliation remains ambiguous by design: the table fails closed (local VOIDED, original error) while the durable round may be SETTLED; this is documented, not claimed reconciled.
R4-ART-0007 task/artifact metadata do not pin table.py, so the pre-authorised R4-ART provenance repin was not needed and no art metadata changed.

The collaboration gate requires this packet to carry PASS for both required commands before validate_baseline.py can pass; before this packet and the 1.2.0 artifact were written, both commands failed only on the stale 1.1.0 artifact pin of table.py (unittest: 905 tests, errors=5), and both were re-run on the final tree with this packet in place.
No commit or push was made by the implementer; Codex owns the Git workflow. Temporary isolated workspaces only; no live databases, network, package installs or settings changes.

known_risks.description: Storage-read outage during post-commit reconciliation (draw_record or submit_round replay raising): the table fails closed with local VOIDED and the original error while the durable round may be SETTLED. Balances are store-derived and reload_history recovers the round once storage answers; the player sees no result for that round until then. Documented, not claimed reconciled.

If the store read inside _snapshot fails after the round was adopted, the round is SETTLED with its result but without a journal entry, so a same-id retry is PHASE_DENIED instead of a replay (a refusal, not a false success).

Store-owned, unchanged: submit_round skips the durable void for BaseException (KeyboardInterrupt) after a sampled-then-rolled-back draw; only the table phase guard prevents a redraw within the process. Forced SETTLING -> VOIDED still records no history entry (pre-existing).

apply_patch wrote LF lines into the CRLF working copy of table.py; git text=auto normalises the index and git diff shows only the intended hunks. Codex should confirm the committed blob before merging.

The preliminary Claude reviewer rejection of 1.1.0 stands until that reviewer or A-50 re-examines 1.2.0; Codex verification, browser QA and the final A-50/USER gate are outstanding. This packet claims none of them.
